name: Tudela (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned arms of the city of Tudela (a bridge with three towers above waves on blue within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: The flag of Tudela follows the design characteristic of other cities and provinces of the middle Ebro valley such as Calahorra, La Almunia or the province of Zaragoza, and is composed of a white cloth of proportions 2/3 on which is superimposed the cross of Saint George with the arms of the city at the centre.
